# tree-ui

> An accessible, zero-dependency tree view component for React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4
> projects that use shadcn/ui CSS variables. Distributed as a shadcn registry item.

## Install

Command:

    npx shadcn@latest add {{REGISTRY_URL}}

The registry item installs exactly three files:

- components/tree/tree.tsx  (registry:ui)
- components/tree/use-tree.ts  (registry:lib)
- components/tree/types.ts  (registry:lib)

The JSON at {{REGISTRY_URL}} embeds the full source of all three files. No npm
package, no runtime dependencies, no context provider, no portals. React and
Tailwind are peer requirements.

## Public API

Tree props:

- data: TreeNode[] — root nodes, `id` must be unique
- aria-label: string — accessible name, required
- selectionMode: "none" | "single" | "multiple" (default "single")
- expandedIds / defaultExpandedIds / onExpandedChange
- selectedIds / defaultSelectedIds / onSelectionChange
- loadChildren: (node) => Promise<TreeNode[]> — async children, cached per id
- onLoadError: (node, error) => void
- renderIcon / renderActions: (node, ctx) => ReactNode
- renderEmpty: () => ReactNode
- indent: number (default 16)
- messages: Partial<TreeMessages> — loading, loadFailed, retry, empty, expand, collapse
- className / itemClassName

TreeNode fields: id, label (ReactNode), children?, icon?, disabled?, searchText?, data?

Behavior notes:

- Children of async nodes load on first expand and stay cached.
- Failed loads render a Retry button and announce through role="status"; Enter on
  the focused failed node retries.
- Keyboard: ArrowUp/Down move, ArrowRight expands or enters a child, ArrowLeft
  collapses or moves to parent, Home/End jump, Enter/Space select, "*" expands
  siblings, printable characters run typeahead, double click toggles.
- Accessible markup: role tree/treeitem with aria-level, aria-posinset,
  aria-setsize, aria-expanded, aria-selected, aria-disabled, aria-busy.
- No window access during render, so it is SSR safe.
